summary: Adds four CAM preferences for ToolBit shape drawing colors and brightness, makes the ToolBit editor's shape drawing interactive (hover/click a dimension to highlight/focus its field), strips dimensions from small shape icons, and turns the Chamfer shape's Diameter into a read-only derived property.

pages.reason: Gui/DlgSettingsPathColor.ui: new 'Tool Bit Shape Drawing' group with Dimension color (light theme, default #111111), Dimension color (dark theme, default #23818d), Dimension highlight color (default #ff8c00) and Tool artwork brightness (dark theme, 10-100 %, default 85); Path/Preferences.py adds the matching Mod/CAM keys

Path/Tool/toolbit/ui/editor.py + shape/ui/shapewidget.py + docobject/ui/docobject.py: ShapeWidget(interactive=True) in the editor; hovering a dimension in the drawing highlights its property field and vice versa, clicking a dimension focuses the field; editor.py load_toolbit hides derived parameters (Chamfer Diameter) from the form and toolbit/models/base.py sets them read-only (setEditorMode 1)

shape/models/chamfer.py: derived_parameters() computes Diameter = TipDiameter + 2*CuttingEdgeHeight*tan(CuttingEdgeAngle/2), so Chamfer Diameter is no longer user-entered; shape/models/icon.py theme_svg() recolors dimensions via #ff0000/#00ff00 sentinels and dim-<label> groups, and toolbit/models/base.py get_thumbnail / shapebutton.py / tablecell.py render icons with dimensions=False
Path/Tool/toolbit/ui/tablecell.py: tool table icons now rendered with dimensions=False and theme-aware colors; text unaffected
Path/Main/Gui/Job.py: _applyButtonIcons only switches to the shared PathGuiTheme.is_dark_theme() helper; behaviour unchanged
DlgSettingsPathColor changes add normal preferences, nothing under the experimental flags

meta.title: CAM: Theme-aware ToolBit shape drawings with dimension/field highlighting
